braider.testSet: 60 locked DMs, never recorded by Mubit

houseRules.1: "Boho" means curls throughout; "curly ends" is a different look.
houseRules.2: Short 4a-4c hair plus waist length or longer: ask for a photo of the current hair before quoting.
houseRules.3: Prices exclude hair unless the client says it's included; say so in the reply.
houseRules.4: "Under £X" is a ceiling, never a quote. Quote the real price and offer a cheaper option if it's over.
houseRules.5: Never confirm a booking from a DM: offer specific slots instead.
houseRules.6: "Smedium" is a real size, between small and medium. Don't set it unless the client chooses it.
houseRules.7: "Me and my sister" or "me and my mum" sets people; a child's hair is referred elsewhere.
houseRules.8: Wig installs are declined; offer what the stylist does instead.
houseRules.9: Day words resolve against the message's received time ("sat" sent on a Sunday means next Saturday).
houseRules.10: The reply asks at most two questions, most important first.
houseRules.11: Photo tags under 0.6 confidence aren't used. Text beats photo; a clash on length or ends becomes a question.

colourist.testSet: 20 locked DMs, never recorded by Mubit

houseRules.4: "Under £X" is a ceiling, never a quote. Quote the real price.
houseRules.5: Never confirm a booking from a DM: offer specific slots instead.
houseRules.7: "Me and my mum" sets people; under-16s are referred elsewhere.
houseRules.9: Day words resolve against the message's received time.
houseRules.10: The reply asks at most two questions, most important first.
houseRules.11: Photo tags under 0.6 confidence aren't used. Text beats photo; a clash on length or shade becomes a question.
houseRules.12: New colour clients need a patch test at least 48 hours before; never offer a colour slot sooner.
houseRules.13: Toner is included with balayage and highlights; a toner on its own is a separate £45 service.
houseRules.14: "Lived-in blonde" means a soft-root balayage, not all-over blonde.
houseRules.15: Box-dyed or previously lightened hair needs a free consultation before any quote (roots and toners excepted).
houseRules.16: Going from naturally dark to blonde can take two sessions; say so.

nails.testSet: 24 locked DMs, never recorded by Mubit

houseRules.4: "Under £X" is a ceiling, never a quote. Quote the real price.
houseRules.5: Never confirm a booking from a DM: offer specific slots instead.
houseRules.7: "Me and my bestie" sets people; under-12s are referred elsewhere.
houseRules.9: Day words resolve against the message's received time.
houseRules.10: The reply asks at most two questions, most important first.
houseRules.11: Photo tags under 0.6 confidence aren't used. Text beats photo; a clash on length or shape becomes a question.
houseRules.17: Gel or acrylic from another salon needs a £10 soak-off; removing my own work is free. If it's unclear whether they have product on, ask.
houseRules.18: Bitten or very short nails: ask for a photo of their nails now before booking extensions.
houseRules.19: Green or yellow patches, lifting with discolouration, or a suspected infection: don't book. Refer them to a pharmacist or GP, kindly.
houseRules.21: Infills are only within 3 weeks of the set; after that it's a new full set.
houseRules.22: A design from Pinterest or TikTok needs a photo of it before art is quoted.
